olders.part: §5 "Every drive ends in a review" and Open Question 1 - the review is the drive's last step, not a drive of its own; it looks at the outcome (intents and product model), never the plays. This also settles how §2's "the plays' reviews happen after the drive ends" is done: the person answers the plays' review records through the outcome, not play by play.

§5, the bullet "Inside a drive, big updates are ... approved together at the drive's end review" - the plan is not shown in the review; the drive's big plan updates are marked approved when the person's answers are applied, in the same commit.

§5 "No approval stop inside a drive" - the person confirms or drops the proposed intents in the intent review tool at the drive's last step, not "the review and the pull request at its end"; they may also send an intent back with a comment.

Decision, "Review happens through the feature-branch git diff and the end-sequence PR" - inside a drive the person reviews the model writes in the two review tools, by meaning; the pull request only lands them. Write-then-review itself is kept.
